admission.justification: The five members distinguish optional card authorship from initialization, baseline admission and knowledge foundation: current Curator rules and templates govern card content, measured fixer admission governs optional card repair, first-baseline admission rejects legacy cards, setup orders initialization/adoption without requiring cards, and memory_init reports observed knowledge state with its next step. These conditional responsibilities jointly prevent setup artifacts from being presented as an authored knowledge foundation; each member retains its own applicability.

guarantee: Converted-memory setup attributes the first baseline before new-root foundation authoring and reports the actual knowledge state and its named next step for an Architect-owned task according to the observed memory revision, without making onboarding a setup prerequisite. When onboarding is authored, converted card shape, admitted fixer authority and the prohibition on legacy-format first-baseline cards apply. Neither cards nor an attributed baseline establish an authored knowledge foundation.
title: converted-first-baseline-with-truthful-handoff
